title: What is visual identity?

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Make the idea of identity tangible because people encounter a city through visible communications, not an abstract definition.
strategic_value: A photograph of Helsinki print material can connect the city’s identity vocabulary to everyday communication.
demonstration: This expanded webpage section defines visual identity in four bullets and follows them with a photograph of a green publication spread.
practical_value: Distinguish a visual identity from an isolated logo by considering all visible communications.

content_islands.name: Definition
content_islands.spec: Place the four explanatory bullets beneath the section heading.

content_islands.name: Applied identity
content_islands.spec: Follow with the publication photograph and its credit.

reference_purposes.Intent: The bullets say visual identity makes a brand visible and helps convey messages.
reference_purposes.Application: The publication photograph places graphic identity in a printed communication.
